summary: Lemma-level coefficient algebra for deformation and patching: genuine fixed-residue Artinian and complete Noetherian local algebras, their extensions and quotient towers, local continuous power-series presentations, the local specialization of the imported adic tensor product, and coefficient change with the finiteness hypotheses exposed. The base residue field is arbitrary. Native completion, graded-ring and Witt-vector constructions are imported rather than planned again. This planning pass covers the stage targets and stops at 106 declarations for independent review. Coverage is planned, not closed: seven precise proof-interface gaps and three supplier-prefix rescopings remain explicit.

Their p-basis, representative and pre-Cohen directed-union infrastructure has no native interface found at the pins and has not been decomposed to lemmas here. This is an explicit refinement gap for the perfect-hull map, not a use of separable lifting across a purely inseparable extension.

gaps.title: Local-field diagonal completions and pseudocompact coefficient comparison
gaps.detail: BIP23 Lemmas3.35–3.37, pp.24–25, are read in the published version. The proof imports [9,Lemmas3.3.4–3.3.5], the one-element differential p-basis diagonal calculation, and topological Nakayama for pseudocompact modules. The finite-type native smooth-field theorem and finite-module Nakayama do not provide these interfaces. Their exact relative coefficient-completion comparison, including separated kernel and actual maps, remains unestablished here.

sourceIssues.locator: Lemma3.35, printed p.24, version of record, Forum of Mathematics, Pi 11 (2023), e30
